description_en: Quickly and accurately detects key field information from a Medical Device Business License, including license number, company name, registered address, legal representative, enterprise owner, quality manager, warehouse address, business scope, validity period, and issuance date
description_zh: 可快速精准的识别医疗器械经营许可证所包含许可证编号、企业名称、注册地址、法定代表人、企业负责人、质量管理人、仓库地址、经营范围、许可期限、发证日期等关键字段信息
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-medical-device-manage-license --url https://img.alicdn.com/tfs/TB1ZrF.MuL2gK0jSZFmXXc7iXXa-1417-995.png --biz-body '图片二进制文件' --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeMedicalDeviceManageLicense

parameters.help_en: Image URL (must not exceed 2048 bytes; Base64 encoding is not supported)
parameters.help_zh: 图片链接（长度不超2048字节，不支持base64）
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en: Binary file of the image, up to 10 MB. Either this parameter or the URL parameter must be provided. When using HTTP, place the binary image data in the HTTP body for upload. When using the software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK body
parameters.help_zh: 图片二进制文件，最大10MB，与URL二选一。 使用HTTP方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到HTTP body 中上传即可。 使用SDK的方式调用，把图片放到SDK的body中即可
parameters.name: body

Code.description_en: Error code (this field is not returned if detection succeeded)
Code.description_zh: 错误码（如果识别成功，不会返回此字段）
